title.zh: From Kaiko to OpenZeppelin, S&P Global is quietly preparing for markets that never close
title.en: From Kaiko to OpenZeppelin, S&P Global is quietly preparing for markets that never close

current_state.zh: S&P Global agreed to acquire smart contract security firm OpenZeppelin, days after leading an investment in crypto-data provider Kaiko, expanding its digital asset footprint across market data, benchmarks, and technology risk for tokenized finance.
